title: Exact and Approximate Range Queries in Ball Mapper
abstract: arXiv:2601.01405v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ball Mapper summarizes a finite metric dataset by covering the sample with closed balls centered at selected landmarks and connecting landmarks whose balls share observations. Its construction therefore depends critically on repeated fixed radius range queries, yet the effect of replacing exact queries by approximate search has not been systematically characterized. We formulate Ball Mapper through an abstract range query procedure that separates the mathematical construction from the search backend used to realize it. Under fixed ordering, exact procedures preserve the landmark sequence, cover, graph, and membership-based colorings. For approximate procedures, we derive deterministic bounds on covering radius and landmark separation under additive and multiplicative query errors, prove inclusions for the induced nerve, characterize edge survival through witness redundancy for conservative approximations, and bound perturbation

translated_title: Ball Mapper中的精确与近似范围查询
translated_abstract: Ball Mapper通过以选定地标为中心的闭球覆盖有限度量数据集，并连接其球共享观测点的地标来概括数据。因此，其构造关键地依赖于重复的固定半径范围查询，然而用近似搜索替代精确查询所产生的影响尚未被系统地刻画。我们通过一个抽象的范围查询过程来表述Ball Mapper，从而将数学构造与用于实现它的搜索后端分离开来。在固定排序下，精确过程保持地标序列、覆盖、图以及基于成员关系的着色不变。对于近似过程，我们在加性和乘性查询误差下推导出覆盖半径和地标分离的确定性界限，证明了诱导神经（nerve）的包含关系，通过见证冗余刻画了保守近似下的边存活情况，并对扰动进行了界定。
tldr: 该论文通过抽象范围查询框架系统刻画了Ball Mapper中精确与近似搜索的影响，证明了精确查询保持构造不变，并为近似查询推导出覆盖半径、地标分离和边存活的确定性理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically characterizes exact and approximate range queries in Ball Mapper through an abstract query framework, proving that exact queries preserve the construction while deriving deterministic guarantees on covering radius, landmark separation, and edge survival for approximate queries.
